name: omp-manager
description: A local, capability-driven desktop manager for Oh My Pi

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@omp-manager/desktop && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
